metadata.title: Relugolix Therapy
metadata.indication: Relugolix for advanced hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

action.message: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

rules.explanation: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

action.message: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

rules.explanation: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

action.message: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

rules.explanation: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

action.message: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

rules.explanation: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

action.message: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

rules.explanation: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

action.message: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

source.scope_note: Implementation safety guard based on the cited exclusion, dosing or warning; not a verbatim NCCP numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

action.message: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

rules.explanation: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

action.message: Severe renal impairment/dialysis: limited evidence; specialist review. No numeric reduction is specified and no CrCl threshold is invented.

rules.explanation: Severe renal impairment/dialysis: limited evidence; specialist review. No numeric reduction is specified and no CrCl threshold is invented.

action.message: Severe hepatic impairment has not been adequately studied; specialist review. No evidence-based automatic dose adjustment is specified.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment has not been adequately studied; specialist review. No evidence-based automatic dose adjustment is specified.

action.message: Take the missed dose when remembered if no more than 12 hours late; do not double doses. Check the full interruption history.

rules.explanation: Take the missed dose when remembered if no more than 12 hours late; do not double doses. Check the full interruption history.

action.message: Omit this missed dose only; resume the usual schedule the next day. This does not mean permanently stopping treatment.

rules.explanation: Omit this missed dose only; resume the usual schedule the next day. This does not mean permanently stopping treatment.

action.message: After an interruption greater than 7 days, NCCP specifies a 360 mg loading dose on restart, then 120 mg once daily. Confirm the reason for interruption and any ongoing interacting inducer with pharmacy before prescribing the restart.

rules.explanation: After an interruption greater than 7 days, NCCP specifies a 360 mg loading dose on restart, then 120 mg once daily. Confirm the reason for interruption and any ongoing interacting inducer with pharmacy before prescribing the restart.

action.message: Avoid oral P-gp inhibitors if possible. If unavoidable, take relugolix first, then the inhibitor at least 6 hours later; monitor more closely. A short-course interruption up to 2 weeks may be considered; apply the >7-day restart rule.

rules.explanation: Avoid oral P-gp inhibitors if possible. If unavoidable, take relugolix first, then the inhibitor at least 6 hours later; monitor more closely. A short-course interruption up to 2 weeks may be considered; apply the >7-day restart rule.

action.message: Avoid combined P-gp and strong CYP3A inducers. If unavoidable, NCCP specifies relugolix 240 mg once daily during co-administration, returning to 120 mg once daily after the inducer is discontinued. Pharmacy must reconcile initiation or restart dosing.

rules.explanation: Avoid combined P-gp and strong CYP3A inducers. If unavoidable, NCCP specifies relugolix 240 mg once daily during co-administration, returning to 120 mg once daily after the inducer is discontinued. Pharmacy must reconcile initiation or restart dosing.

action.message: Recheck the dose, timing and interruption history when an interacting medicine is stopped. After a combined inducer, return to the recommended 120 mg daily under the prescribing plan.

rules.explanation: Recheck the dose, timing and interruption history when an interacting medicine is stopped. After a combined inducer, return to the recommended 120 mg daily under the prescribing plan.

action.message: Relugolix itself supplies medical androgen deprivation. Confirm switching timing and avoid unintended duplicate GnRH treatment; do not automatically add it to an existing depot.

source.scope_note: Implementation safety guard based on the cited exclusion, dosing or warning; not a verbatim NCCP numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: Relugolix itself supplies medical androgen deprivation. Confirm switching timing and avoid unintended duplicate GnRH treatment; do not automatically add it to an existing depot.

administration.dose: 360 mg loading dose day 1, then 120 mg once daily
administration.instructions: May be taken with or without food; swallow whole. If a dose is >12 hours late, omit it.

treatment.schedule_summary: Relugolix 360 mg on the first day, then 120 mg once daily without planned breaks. Your specialist sets the duration and any prescribed changes.
treatment.duration_text: Individual duration according to disease setting and treatment plan

regular: Disease and safety monitoring according to treatment plan and NCCP source.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: The NCCP regimen classifies this oral SACT as minimal emetogenic risk; the linked oral minimal-to-low supportive-care guidance is used rather than a parenteral prescription sheet.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT

indications.description: Treatment of adult patients with advanced hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
